wanted_board_desc: Notices for those who hunt and gather. Take one, do the deed, and hand it in at any board's box for your reward.
wanted_board_hint: Look at a notice to read it.
wanted_notice_desc: A notice taken from a Wanted board. Do what it asks, then put it in any Wanted board's box to be paid.
wanted_too_many: You can carry only {0} notices at a time.
wanted_dropped: No room in your bag: the notice is at your feet.
wanted_status_done: Done: hand it in at a Wanted board's box
wanted_done: Notice done: {0}. Hand it in at a Wanted board's box.
wanted_box_full: The box has no room for the reward.
wanted_already_paid: That notice has already been paid.
wanted_too_close: Another Wanted board is {0} m away: boards need {1} m between them.
wanted_board_empty: No notices yet. New ones are posted at dawn.
